alt: A slender golden-tan street dog sits quietly on a grey road, gazing to the side with a calm expression.
caption: A quiet moment on the streets of Nepal.

alt: A chocolate-and-white Siberian Husky with icy blue eyes sits on green grass, looking up with its tongue out and fluffy tail curled behind.
caption: A playful spirit beneath the afternoon light.

alt: A small cream, grey and brown sparrow perches on a weathered rusty metal railing against a softly blurred green background.
caption: A little pause in the morning stillness.

alt: A smiling Nepali wedding couple poses in a cobbled courtyard. The groom wears a red patterned topi and grey blazer, while the bride wears a richly embroidered red lehenga, gold and green jewellery and a red veil.
caption: A celebration of love and Nepali tradition.

alt: Colorful Buddhist prayer flags cross a rocky pine-covered mountainside above a boulder painted with Tibetan sacred script and a bright Buddhist wheel beside a small white stupa.
caption: Faith carried by the mountain wind.

alt: A suspension bridge crosses a pale glacial river in a wide Himalayan valley surrounded by rugged mountains, low clouds, scattered buildings and a winding dirt road.
caption: A crossing through the heart of the Himalayas.

alt: A one-horned rhinoceros grazes in a green grassland beneath a broad tree, with golden morning sunlight filtering through the mist and a stream winding through the meadow.
caption: Where the wild begins its day.

alt: A lush green tree stands in a manicured garden, surrounded by an octagonal brick border and neatly trimmed hedges beneath a hazy sky.
caption: A quiet place beneath the green canopy.
